ReportItem.pluginName: Microsoft Windows SMBv1 Multiple Remote Code Execution (EternalBlue)
ReportItem.synopsis: The remote Windows host is affected by multiple remote code execution vulnerabilities in SMBv1.
ReportItem.description: The remote Windows host is affected by multiple vulnerabilities in the SMBv1 implementation that allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges via crafted SMB packets.
ReportItem.solution: Apply Microsoft security update MS17-010 or disable SMBv1 across all domain controllers via Group Policy.
ReportItem.plugin_output: SMBv1 is active and responds to unauthenticated tree connect requests.

ReportItem.pluginName: Active Directory Kerberos Pre-Authentication Security Elevation
ReportItem.synopsis: Kerberos authentication protocol vulnerability allows privilege escalation.
ReportItem.description: The Kerberos KDC fails to adequately enforce encryption algorithm restrictions on ticket granting requests, allowing elevation of privilege from standard domain user to Enterprise Admin.
ReportItem.solution: Deploy Microsoft cumulative update KB5019966 and enforce AES-256 for Kerberos ticket encryption.

ReportItem.pluginName: Terminal Services Encryption Level is Not FIPS-140 Compliant
ReportItem.synopsis: Remote Desktop Services encryption does not meet high assurance standards.
ReportItem.description: The remote RDP service permits client-compatible encryption levels instead of enforcing TLS 1.3 with FIPS-validated cryptography.
ReportItem.solution: Configure 'Set client connection encryption level' to 'High Level' or 'FIPS Compliant' via GPO.

ReportItem.pluginName: PostgreSQL Superuser Privilege Escalation via Extension Scripts
ReportItem.synopsis: The remote database is vulnerable to arbitrary code execution.
ReportItem.description: PostgreSQL versions prior to 15.4, 14.9, or 13.12 contain a flaw where an unprivileged database user can execute arbitrary code with database superuser privileges via crafted extension install scripts.
ReportItem.solution: Upgrade PostgreSQL server packages to version 15.4 / 14.9 or higher and revoke CREATE perms from PUBLIC schema.

ReportItem.pluginName: SSH Server Supports Weak CBC Ciphers
ReportItem.synopsis: The SSH service allows obsolete cipher suites.
ReportItem.description: The SSH daemon supports CBC mode ciphers which are susceptible to plaintext recovery attacks.
ReportItem.solution: Update /etc/ssh/sshd_config to only allow chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com and aes256-gcm@openssh.com.
